subject: Contract finish line: MSA / DPA / Order Form orchestration
messages:
From: Michael Turner <m.turner@crescentht.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
Cc: Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@crescentht.com>, contracts@crescentht.com
Date: 2026-08-07 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Initial procurement timeline for pilot – contract dependencies

Hi Rachel,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — team was impressed with the latency numbers and the model switch strategy. Procurement asked me to put together a single timeline that shows what we need from Legal to get pilot access: MSA in place, DPA review, and the order form to pick capacity and billing cadence.

High level asks from our side:
- Can you confirm which MSA template you expect Crescent to sign?
- Is the DPA your standard one or a customer-specific addendum?
- We need an order form that lists committed GPU-hours vs burst capacity.

We're trying to align kick-off for pilot onboarding the week of Aug 24. Is that realistic if Legal and Procurement run in parallel? If not, what sequence do you recommend (MSA first then DPA then order form, or overlap)?

If helpful I can share Crescent internal procurement SLAs — they typically take 7–10 business days for standard MSAs and another 5–7 for DPAs.

—Michael
Procurement Lead, Crescent HealthTech


From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
To: Michael Turner <m.turner@crescentht.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-07 10:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Contract finish line: MSA / DPA / Order Form orchestration

Hi Michael — thanks for the clear asks. Short answer: we can run Legal and Procurement activities in parallel but we need a few gating pieces in the right order to hit Aug 24. I've attached a short Mutual Action Plan (MAP) and a proposed sequencing that minimizes rework.

Key sequencing I recommend:
1) Exchange MSA template (we provide our latest MSA + preferred redlines) — target 3 business days for Crescent to confirm if standard.
2) Parallel DPA review — we provide a standard DPA; if you need custom controls we'll track via an addendum. DPA review can run while MSA redlines are negotiated.
3) Order form draft (pricing & capacity) — complete once MSA commercial terms (billing cadence, indemnities) are agreed in principal.

If Crescent procurement SLA is 7–10 business days for MSAs, we can compress by committing to a two-cycle negotiation: initial redline review within 3–4 business days and finalization within 2–3. That requires legal reviewers from both sides to be available for quick turnarounds.

I'm looping in Laura (legal ops) and Karthik (contracts) so they can confirm resource availability and outline any non-negotiable clauses. Vanessa will own the order form / pricing checklist.

Attachments: 2026-08-07_Redwood_MAP_draft.pdf (MAP with proposed milestones)

Next step: Laura, can you confirm if we should push MSA first or allow heavier overlap with DPA?

Thanks,
Rachel
Director, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Michael Turner <m.turner@crescentht.com>
Date: 2026-08-07 12:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Contract finish line: MSA / DPA / Order Form orchestration

Rachel / team — quick alignment from Legal Ops: we can support parallel tracks with the following constraints:
- MSA must have commercial terms (term, termination, fees, indemnities) agreed before we finalize the Order Form.
- DPA can and should be negotiated in parallel; we'll raise privacy/security items as a separate addendum if Crescent needs non-standard controls.
- If Crescent sends heavy redlines to the MSA (e.g., broad indemnities or data residency requirements), we should treat those as escalation points and expect an extra 5 business days.

Operationally I'm proposing this condensed schedule if Crescent commits to rapid review:
- Aug 7 (today): Exchange MSA & DPA (we've attached the standard DPA summary).
- Aug 10: Crescent provides initial redlines to MSA; procurement confirms order form header fields (capacity, start date, billing cadence).
- Aug 12: Redwood provides counter-redlines and a draft Order Form with proposed units/pricing.
- Aug 14–18: Final negotiation and internal approvals (we'll reserve Aug 21 as a slack day for signing).

This schedule assumes both sides will do single-cycle redline responses and that Crescent's legal team can triage the MSA comments within 48–72 hours. If Crescent needs extra review time, the Aug 24 onboarding will slip.

Attachments included for Crescent: DPA_summary_v1.pdf

Laura Bennett
Head of Legal Ops | Redwood Inference

From: Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@crescentht.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
Cc: Michael Turner <m.turner@crescentht.com>, contracts@crescentht.com
Date: 2026-08-09 08:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Contract finish line: MSA / DPA / Order Form orchestration

Rachel / Laura — appreciate the MAP and the accelerated timeline. A few items from Crescent procurement/legal:
- We will review the MSA and push a subset of redlines by Aug 10; full redline may come later depending on our counsel.
- Data residency: Crescent requires EU processing controls for patient-data-derived prompts. We need a DPA addendum confirming processing locations and SOC2 attestations.
- Billing cadence: Procurement prefers monthly in arrears for pilot, but Finance may ask for net-30 on the pilot invoice. Can the Order Form include both options?

We are uploading our standard redline template to your Drive folder and I've copied our contracts alias. Expect initial comments by Aug 10.

Sarah Lee
Senior Procurement Manager | Crescent HealthTech
Attachments: Crescent_Redline_Template.docx (see Drive)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: Michael Turner <m.turner@crescentht.com>, Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@crescentht.com>
Date: 2026-08-10 15:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Contract finish line: MSA / DPA / Order Form orchestration — sequencing confirmed

All — quick update after reviewing Crescent's note and their Drive upload. Key decisions so we have one source of truth:

1) MSA exchange: Redwood will upload our MSA with preferred redlines by COB today (attached: MSA_Crescent_Redlines_20260809.docx). Crescent to provide initial redlines by Aug 11 EOD.
2) DPA: Laura will produce a DPA addendum that explicitly lists processing regions and SOC2 link; target Aug 11 for our first pass.
3) Order Form: Vanessa to prepare two versions in parallel — (a) monthly in arrears for pilot, (b) net-30 payment term option. OrderForm_vFinal.xlsx will be sent Aug 12 morning.
4) Escalation points: data residency + indemnity cap. If Crescent pushes on residency beyond the addendum we should escalate to Legal Leadership.

Operational ask from Crescent: please confirm the single-point reviewer on your side for MSA redlines so we don't get parallel threads of edits. Michael / Sarah — please confirm who will own that on Crescent's side.

I'll track the MAP milestones in HubSpot and shared Drive. DocuSign link will be prepared once we have final signatures.

Karthik Iyer
Contracts Lead | Redwood Inference
Attachments: MSA_Crescent_Redlines_20260809.docx, OrderForm_vFinal.xlsx
